configuration:
fs.defaultFS hdfs://zookage
hadoop.tmp.dir /mnt/hadoop
hadoop.security.credential.provider.path localjceks://file/etc/hadoop/secrets/hadoop.jceks
hadoop.proxyuser.httpfs.hosts *
hadoop.proxyuser.httpfs.groups *
hadoop.proxyuser.hive.hosts *
hadoop.proxyuser.hive.groups *
hadoop.security.authorization {{ or (index .Values "hadoop_security_authorization") "false" | html }}
hadoop.security.authentication {{ or (index .Values "hadoop_security_authentication") "simple" | html }}
hadoop.kerberos.keytab.login.autorenewal.enabled true
hadoop.rpc.protection {{ or (index .Values "hadoop_rpc_protection") "authentication" | html }}
ipc.client.fallback-to-simple-auth-allowed {{ or (index .Values "hadoop_ipc_client_fallback_to_simple_auth_allowed") "false" | html }}
{{- if index .Values "hadoop_http_authentication_type" }}
hadoop.http.authentication.type {{ index .Values "hadoop_http_authentication_type" | html }}
hadoop.http.authentication.kerberos.principal {{ index .Values "hadoop_http_authentication_kerberos_principal" | html }}
hadoop.http.authentication.kerberos.keytab {{ index .Values "hadoop_http_authentication_kerberos_keytab" | html }}
{{- end }}
hadoop.security.group.mapping org.apache.hadoop.security.LdapGroupsMapping
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.url ldap://openldap-server:389
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.bind.user cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.userbase ou=users,dc=example,dc=com
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.search.filter.user (&(objectClass=posixAccount)(uid={0}))
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.groupbase ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.search.filter.group (objectClass=posixGroup)
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.posix.attr.uid.name uid
hadoop.security.group.mapping.ldap.search.attr.member memberUid
ha.zookeeper.quorum zookeeper-server-0.zookeeper-server:2181,zookeeper-server-1.zookeeper-server:2181,zookeeper-server-2.zookeeper-server:2181
hadoop.zk.address zookeeper-server-0.zookeeper-server:2181,zookeeper-server-1.zookeeper-server:2181,zookeeper-server-2.zookeeper-server:2181
hadoop.registry.zk.quorum zookeeper-server-0.zookeeper-server:2181,zookeeper-server-1.zookeeper-server:2181,zookeeper-server-2.zookeeper-server:2181
fs.s3a.connection.ssl.enabled false
fs.s3a.endpoint ozone-s3g:9878
fs.s3a.fast.upload.buffer bytebuffer
fs.s3a.committer.name magic
fs.s3a.path.style.access true
fs.s3a.change.detection.version.required false
fs.s3a.change.detection.mode none
